description: Take leads out of a campaign: up to 1,000 by id in `contactIds`, or, with `invalid: true` instead, every known-invalid lead, however many: an address a checking service or the contacts file said does not exist, or one on a reserved domain such as .local or .test. A lead whose domain our own look found no mail route for stays (`invalidForNow`): that answer is checked again after 24 hours. The contacts themselves stay. An id that is not a lead here is skipped.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

invalid.description: Take out every known-invalid lead instead of naming ids: an address a checking service or the contacts file said does not exist, or one on a reserved domain such as .local or .test. A domain our own check found no mail route for is left in: that answer is checked again after 24 hours.

name: remove_campaign_leads
title: Remove leads
